name: claimtrace
description: Local-first auditing for versioned analytical claims, evidence, decisions, and review records.

scripts.cases:generate: node --import tsx tools/generate-public-data-cases.ts && node tools/generate-case-fixtures.mjs && node --import tsx tools/generate-case-audits.ts
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test tests/core.test.ts tests/demo-data.test.ts tests/cases.test.ts tests/refresh-public-data-sources.test.ts tests/benchmark.test.ts tests/property.test.ts tests/import-policy.test.ts tests/workspace-workflows.test.ts tests/english-only.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser:readonly && npm run test:browser:writable
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --include='src/core/**/*.ts' --reporter=text --reporter=html --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --statements=95 --lines=95 --functions=95 --branches=75 node --import tsx --test tests/core.test.ts tests/cases.test.ts tests/benchmark.test.ts tests/property.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:built-artifact
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run demo:generate && npm run cases:generate && npm run benchmark && npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:coverage
